column2: A tapestry woven with hunting scenes hung on the castle wall to keep the hall warm.
column3: 一幅織有狩獵場景的掛毯懸掛在城堡牆上，使大廳保暖。
column5: tapestry 像 tape 線帶：一條條彩線織成大壁毯

column2: Her embroidery of tiny red flowers covered the edge of the white scarf.
column3: 她繡的小紅花圖案佈滿了白色圍巾的邊緣。
column5: em 嗯嗯，一針一線在布上畫出圖案

column2: He practiced calligraphy every morning, dipping a brush in ink to form each character slowly.
column3: 他每天早上練習書法，用毛筆沾墨，慢慢寫出每一個字。
column5: calli 美麗 + graphy 書寫：把字寫得漂亮

column2: Monks copied the prayers onto parchment, a sheet made from stretched animal skin.
column3: 修士把禱文抄寫在羊皮紙上，這是一種由拉平的獸皮製成的紙張。
column5: parchment 源自古城 Pergamon，那裡的羊皮紙很有名
column8: 羊皮紙；古代經典抄寫材料

column2: The royal charter was written on vellum, a smooth calfskin that can last for centuries.
column3: 這份皇家特許狀寫在犢皮紙上，這是一種光滑的小牛皮，可以保存數百年。
column4: written on vellum (寫在犢皮紙上)
column5: vellum 和 veal 小牛肉同家族：小牛皮做的紙

column2: Each page of the manuscript contained an illumination of gold leaf and bright blue ink around its first letter.
column3: 手抄本每一頁的首字母周圍，都有以金箔與亮藍墨水繪成的彩飾。
column5: illuminate 是照亮：用金色讓字母閃閃發光

column2: The library keeps a medieval manuscript, copied by hand, that exists in no other copy.
column3: 圖書館收藏著一份手抄的中世紀手稿，世上沒有第二份。
column5: manu 手 + script 書寫：用手寫出來的

column2: Iconography in the painting, such as a lamb and a halo, tells viewers which saint is shown.
column3: 畫中的圖像元素，例如羔羊與光環，告訴觀者畫的是哪位聖人。
column5: icon 圖像 + graphy 書寫：用圖像寫成的語言

column2: The wave motif repeats along the border of the vase, tying the whole design together.
column3: 浪花母題沿著花瓶邊緣重複出現，把整個設計串在一起。
column5: motif 像 motive 動機：一再出現的小圖案
column8: 核心主題；裝飾圖案；母題

column2: The choir's voices blended in perfect harmony, each note supporting the others.
column3: 合唱團的聲音完美地融成和聲，每個音符都支撐著其他音符。
column5: harmony 諧音「哈蒙你」：哈，大家和和氣氣合在一起
column8: 和聲；和諧；音樂結構平衡

column2: The cello's rich resonance filled the hall long after the last note was played.
column3: 大提琴渾厚的共鳴，在最後一個音奏完許久之後仍充滿大廳。
column5: re 再 + son 聲音：聲音再響一次

column2: A flute and a violin can play the same note, yet their timbre makes them easy to tell apart.
column3: 長笛和小提琴可以奏出同一個音，但音色讓兩者很容易區分。
column5: timbre 唸「坦波」：一聽聲音就知道是誰在談話

column2: The conductor slowed the tempo so the dancers could keep up with the music.
column3: 指揮放慢速度，讓舞者能跟上音樂。
column5: tempo 在義大利文就是 time 時間：音樂走多快

column2: The pitch of the whistle rose as the kettle heated, until it became a sharp squeal.
column3: 隨著水壺加熱，哨音的音高升高，最後變成尖銳的叫聲。
column5: pitch 像 pitcher 投手：把聲音投得高或低

column2: Even after one hearing, the children could hum the melody of the song.
column3: 即使只聽過一次，孩子們也能哼出那首歌的旋律。
column5: melody 諧音「妹樂地」：妹妹開心哼唱的那條調子

column2: The drummer kept a steady rhythm while the singer waited for her cue.
column3: 鼓手保持穩定的節奏，歌手則等待自己的提示。
column5: 拼字口訣：Rhythm Helps Your Two Hips Move

column2: The phrase closed with a gentle cadence that made listeners feel the song was finished.
column3: 樂句以柔和的終止式收尾，讓聽眾覺得歌曲已經結束。
column5: cad 是落下，像 decay：旋律落下並停住

column2: The symphony has four movements, the last one ending with loud drums and brass.
column3: 這首交響曲有四個樂章，最後一個樂章以響亮的鼓聲與銅管作結。
column5: sym 一起 + phon 聲音：許多樂器一起發聲

column2: She performed a violin concerto in which the soloist and the orchestra seem to take turns leading.
column3: 她演奏了一首小提琴協奏曲，其中獨奏者與樂團似乎輪流帶領。
column5: con 一起 + cert 較量：獨奏和樂團互相較勁
column8: 協奏曲；獨奏與樂團競演

column2: Beethoven's piano sonata follows a classical plan with several movements, each in a different mood.
column3: 貝多芬的鋼琴奏鳴曲遵循古典的多樂章結構，每個樂章的情緒各不相同。
column5: sonata 來自義大利文 suonare「發聲」：被奏響的曲子
column8: 奏鳴曲；古典多樂章體裁

column2: The orchestra tuned their instruments while the audience quietly found their seats.
column3: 樂團調整樂器時，觀眾安靜地找到座位。
column5: orchestra 原指古希臘劇場跳舞的空地，後來樂師坐在那裡

column2: The maestro raised his baton, and the entire hall fell silent.
column3: 大師舉起指揮棒，整座大廳安靜下來。
column5: maestro 在義大利文是「老師」，像 master 大師

column2: The young virtuoso played the violin so brilliantly that critics compared her to a legend.
column3: 這位年輕的演奏名家小提琴拉得太精湛，評論家把她比作傳奇人物。
column5: virtu 和 virtue 同家族，原指出眾的才能與技藝

column2: Her theatrical gestures, such as sweeping her arms and sighing loudly, made the whole class laugh.
column3: 她誇張的戲劇性手勢，例如大幅揮動手臂與大聲嘆氣，逗得全班大笑。
column5: theater 劇場 + ical 的：像在舞台上表演一樣

column2: The drama builds as two rival families fight over land, reaching its peak in the final act.
column3: 劇情隨著兩個敵對家族爭奪土地而升溫，並在最後一幕達到高潮。
column5: drama 在希臘文是「做、行動」：舞台上有動作和衝突

column2: In the classical tragedy, a proud king loses everything because of a single mistake.
column3: 在這齣古典悲劇中，一位驕傲的國王因為一個錯誤而失去一切。
column5: tragedy 在古希臘原指「山羊之歌」，主角走向失敗

column2: The comedy ends happily when the misunderstanding is cleared up and the lovers are reunited.
column3: 這齣喜劇在誤會解開、戀人重逢時圓滿落幕。
column5: comedy 諧音「康妹地」：康妹笑得好開心

column2: The protagonist of the novel is a shy girl who must save her village from drought.
column3: 這部小說的主角是一個害羞的女孩，她必須讓村莊度過乾旱。
column5: proto 第一 + agon 競爭者：第一個站出來競爭的人

column2: In the film, the antagonist is a mayor who tries to block the protagonist's plan to build a school.
column3: 電影中的反派是一位市長，他設法阻撓主角蓋學校的計畫。
column5: anti 對抗 + agon 競爭者：對著主角來的人

column2: Alone on stage, the prince delivered a soliloquy and revealed doubts he could tell no one.
column3: 王子獨自站在舞台上說出一段獨白，吐露他不能對任何人說的疑慮。
column5: soli 單獨 + loqu 說：一個人自己說話

column2: The comedian's opening monologue lasted ten minutes and covered everything from traffic to cats.
column3: 喜劇演員的開場獨白長達十分鐘，從交通談到貓，無所不包。
column5: mono 單一 + logue 話語：一個人講的長篇話
column8: 長篇獨白；單人演講段落

column2: The film's dialogue is so natural that viewers feel they are listening to real friends.
column3: 這部電影的對白非常自然，觀眾彷彿在聽真正的朋友聊天。
column5: dia 之間 + logue 話語：兩個人之間的話

column2: Unlike poetry, prose runs in ordinary sentences and paragraphs without line breaks for rhythm.
column3: 與詩不同，散文以一般的句子與段落書寫，不為節奏而分行。
column5: prose 就是平常說話的樣子：不押韻、不分行
column8: 散文；無韻律平鋪直敘文體

column2: The poem is written in verse, with short lines and a steady rhyme at the end of each.
column3: 這首詩以韻文寫成，詩行很短，每行結尾都有穩定的押韻。
column5: verse 和 reverse 同源「轉」：寫完一行就轉下一行
column8: 詩句；有韻律節奏的詩篇

column2: The Odyssey is an epic that follows one hero's long journey home across the sea.
column3: 《奧德賽》是一部史詩，描寫一位英雄跨海返家的漫長旅程。
column5: epic 諧音「愛皮克」：愛看英雄走遍天下的大故事

column2: The poet's lyric verses express personal feeling, as if she were singing quietly to herself.
column3: 詩人的抒情詩句表達個人情感，彷彿她在輕輕對自己歌唱。
column5: lyric 與 lyre 豎琴同家族：用琴伴著唱出心情

column2: The poet wrote an ode to the autumn wind, praising its power to turn leaves gold.
column3: 詩人寫了一首獻給秋風的頌歌，讚美它能把樹葉吹成金黃的力量。
column5: ode 唸「歐德」，像讚嘆時喊出的一聲 Oh!
column8: 頌歌；讚美崇高的抒情詩

column2: The poet composed an elegy for her teacher, mourning his loss in slow, gentle lines.
column3: 詩人為她的老師寫了一首哀歌，用緩慢而溫柔的詩行哀悼他的離去。
column5: elegy 唸起來像「艾勒吉」，輕輕唱給想念的人

column2: Shakespeare's sonnet follows a strict pattern of fourteen lines, ending with a rhyming couplet.
column3: 莎士比亞的十四行詩遵循嚴格的十四行格式，並以押韻對句收尾。
column4: Shakespearean sonnet (莎士比亞十四行詩)
column5: son 聲音 + net 小：小小的歌，共十四行
column8: 十四行詩；莎翁抒情格律詩

column2: The cartoon is a satire that exaggerates a mayor's habits to mock his careless decisions.
column3: 這幅漫畫是一則諷刺作品，誇大市長的習慣，以嘲笑他草率的決定。
column5: satire 唸「薩特爾」：把壞習慣放在放大鏡下取笑
column8: 諷刺文學；以幽默揭露醜態
